title: Wardrobes built around a chimney breast
summary: IKEA PAX frames either side, joined by an MDF bridge with cupboards over the fireplace.
intro: A full wall of storage that keeps the old fireplace on show. IKEA PAX frames sit either side of the chimney breast, an MDF bridge with overhead cupboards joins them across the top, and flat MDF doors face the lot, so it reads as one piece of furniture.
